name: openalea/plantgl
description: An open-source C++/Python graphic toolkit for the creation, simulation, and analysis of 3D virtual plants, providing geometric primitives, L-system integration, and visualization tools. Foundation of the OpenAlea plant modeling platform.
score_rationale: Comprehensive 3D plant modeling library combining geometry, simulation, and visualization used in plant science research.
summary: C++/Python toolkit for 3D plant creation, simulation, and analysis with L-system integration.
